SELECT SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20) AS reason_desc, AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_ws_quantity, AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_wr_refunded_cash, AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_wr_fee 
FROM web_sales JOIN web_returns ON ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk 
JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk 
JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk 
WHERE d_year = 1998 AND ca_country = 'United States' 
AND (ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') OR ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) 
OR (ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 OR ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250) 
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = COALESCE(wr_refunded_addr_sk, ws_bill_addr_sk) 
JOIN reason ON r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk 
GROUP BY r_reason_desc 
ORDER BY reason_desc, avg_ws_quantity, avg_wr_refunded_cash, avg_wr_fee LIMIT 100
